title: Working Personal Finance for Adults in India
summary: A 4-week, hands-on personal finance course designed to build practical financial self-sufficiency. Learn to track cash flow, eliminate debt, secure appropriate insurance, optimize taxes, and build a resilient long-term investment portfolio using standard Indian instruments.

weeks.theme: Cash Flow, Budgeting, and Debt Elimination

days.title: Auditing Cash Flow and Net Worth
objectives: List all personal assets and liabilities to calculate total net worth in rupees
Categorize bank and UPI transactions from the past 30 days into fixed needs, wants, and savings

days.title: Designing a Zero-Based Monthly Budget
objectives: Allocate monthly take-home income using a modified 50/30/20 framework tailored to local living costs
Identify at least three non-essential recurring expenses that can be negotiated or eliminated

days.title: Constructing an Emergency Fund
objectives: Calculate personal mandatory monthly survival expenses for a 6-month buffer
Select an appropriate split between high-liquidity savings accounts and liquid mutual funds or sweep-in fixed deposits

days.title: Deconstructing High-Cost Debt
objectives: Calculate the effective annualized interest rate of credit card revolving debt and personal loans
Explain why paying only the minimum amount due on a credit card triggers long-term debt accumulation

days.title: Executing Debt Payoff Accelerators
objectives: Draft a side-by-side repayment schedule comparing the debt avalanche and debt snowball strategies
Select the optimal payoff strategy for a given set of consumer debts and establish accelerated payment milestones

weeks.theme: Risk Protection, Credit Health, and Taxes

days.title: Procuring Pure Term Life Insurance
objectives: Calculate required life insurance cover using human life value and liabilities minus liquid assets
Identify red-flag policy features to avoid, including investment-linked endowments and ULIPs

days.title: Selecting Comprehensive Health Insurance
objectives: Evaluate health insurance policies based on room rent limits, copay clauses, and restoration benefits
Structure an optimal base cover plus super top-up policy combination to minimize premium costs

days.title: Managing Credit Score and Banking Security
objectives: Interpret a credit information bureau report (CIBIL/Experian) to identify factors harming the score
Implement concrete measures to keep credit utilization ratio below 30 percent and enable transaction-level security

days.title: Navigating Old vs. New Income Tax Regimes
objectives: Calculate annual tax liability under both the Old and New Income Tax regimes for a salaried individual
Determine which tax regime provides a lower effective tax rate based on eligible deductions

days.title: Optimizing Statutory Tax Deductions
objectives: Compare Section 80C instruments including EPF, PPF, and ELSS on lock-in periods and post-tax returns
Evaluate additional tax-advantaged vehicles such as National Pension System (NPS) under Section 80CCD

days.title: Inflation and Real Returns
objectives: Calculate the real, post-inflation purchasing power of a lump sum over 10 and 20 years
Demonstrate using the Rule of 72 how inflation halves capital without active compounding

days.title: Fixed Income and Capital Preservation
objectives: Compare the risk, liquidity, and post-tax yield of fixed deposits, PPF, and Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGBs)
Calculate post-tax yield on debt instruments based on marginal income tax slabs

days.title: Demystifying Mutual Funds and Indexing
objectives: Differentiate between active equity mutual funds and broad-market index funds (Nifty 50, Nifty Next 50)
Calculate the long-term wealth impact of total expense ratio (TER) differences between regular and direct plans

days.title: Automating Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs)
objectives: Calculate unit accumulation and average purchase price during market drawdowns via rupee cost averaging
Set up an automated monthly SIP mandate aligned with a designated salary credit date

days.title: Constructing an Asset Allocation Framework
objectives: Determine a personal equity-to-debt ratio matching investment horizon and risk tolerance
Construct a diversified starter portfolio divided across broad-market index funds, debt, and liquid instruments

weeks.theme: Goal Planning, Maintenance, and Financial Hygiene

days.title: Reverse-Engineering Time-Bound Goals
objectives: Calculate the required monthly SIP contribution to fund a defined milestone using future value formulas
Categorize financial goals into short-term, medium-term, and long-term buckets with appropriate asset classes

days.title: Calculating the Retirement Independence Corpus
objectives: Calculate targeted retirement corpus using expected annual post-retirement expenses and withdrawal rates
Model the cumulative contribution of compulsory employer retirement savings (EPF/Gratuity) toward the retirement target

days.title: Navigating Capital Gains and Withdrawal Taxes
objectives: Calculate short-term and long-term capital gains tax on equity mutual funds after the annual exempt threshold
Formulate a tax-efficient withdrawal sequence across equity, debt, and liquid reserves

days.title: Executing Annual Portfolio Rebalancing
objectives: Identify asset allocation drift using a 5 percent tolerance band threshold
Formulate rebalancing transactions that realign target weights while minimizing unnecessary capital gains realization

days.title: Setting Up Legal Nominations and Financial Automation
objectives: Audit nomination and joint-holding statuses across all bank accounts, mutual funds, EPF, and insurance policies
Draft a personal master financial inventory document to ensure household continuity in emergencies
